title: RouteSweet Development Handbook
subtitle: Architecture usage troubleshooting and continuing development
subject: Standalone source-grounded project architecture and development reference
introduction: This handbook explains the project from everyday use to the code and data that implement it. Use it to set up a development checkout, follow a request or document through the system, locate the right extension point, make a change, and verify the result.

Begin with the project overview and architecture. The later chapters provide exact local commands, user journeys, worked development examples, diagnostics, recovery steps, known gaps, and a pinned source reference. Technical terms are explained where they are used.

The documented source is COchs-Personal/RouteSweet at b5ef1dc889ba471878ddf22db3683d33614b1858. Source-defined behavior, observed evidence, planned capabilities, and remaining platform work are distinguished. The quick operations guide remains a separate short reference.
